# Standing motion capture

Sam Lazarus recorded the standing performance with Rokoko motion capture equipment. The source file is `Regular_Light_mixamo.fbx` from the IdlesMocapPack_noFACE folder of [Rokoko's 263-asset collection](https://www.rokoko.com/resources/download-263-rokoko-motion-capture-assets). Rokoko permits use in games, including commercial projects. [Everyday idle recordings and usage terms](https://www.rokoko.com/resources/rokoko-mocap-10-free-everyday-idle-animations).

English Archer uses seconds 1–9 of the idle recording. Erika Archer uses 35–43. Each loop retains its recorded torso, shoulder and head motion on the character’s planted stance. Rebuild the character clips with **Bow Man VR > Characters > Bake standing idle** in Unity.

## Bow action recording

`Hawkeye_Archery_mixamo.fbx` comes from the Superhero folder in the same free collection. The full take contains several gestures. English Archer uses the first draw at 4.50–7.25 seconds. Erika uses the following draw at 7.25–9.25 seconds. The two takes reach the nock, full draw and release at the same gameplay cues. The performances drive the torso, pelvis and legs with planted feet. The bow-hand fingers close around the prop. Each performance is mirrored for the other bow hand. Rebuild the four clips in Unity with **Bow Man VR > Characters > Bake opponent bow action**. [Rokoko's motion collection](https://www.rokoko.com/resources/download-263-rokoko-motion-capture-assets)
